verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that AI Gateway serves requests directly from Cloudflare's cache instead of the provider, for faster responses and cost savings. Developers can override cache behavior per request with HTTP headers, and the cf-aig-cache-status header reports HIT or MISS. missing for 10: detail on cache TTL and key configuration, any semantic-caching scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the latency and cost gains.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests

citations.quote: Serve requests directly from Cloudflare's cache instead of the original model provider for faster requests and cost savings.
AI Gateway allows you to override default cache behaviors on a per-request basis using specific HTTP headers.
To check whether a response comes from cache or not, **cf-aig-cache-status** will be designated as `HIT` or `MISS`.
